fields.description:
As a librarian I want agreement names to be validated when creating a subscription agreement so that invalid records cannot be saved.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1: POST /erm/sas with a valid name (1-255 chars) creates the agreement and returns 201.
AC2: POST /erm/sas with a missing or empty name returns 422 with a field error.
AC3: Names longer than 255 characters are rejected with 422.
